decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - Any structural walls relating to the original construction shall be delineated within rooms rather than totally removed or obscured, by piers and arched or flat beams as appropriate. No decorative cornices or features shall be subtracted during dividing up of any rooms, or altering of divisions, or opening up new apertures, unless prior written approval is agreed by the Local Planning Authority . Any existing original finishes, including fittings such as doors, skirtings and dado rails, where affected by proposals, shall be replicated rather than altered to suit the proposal.
description: Conversion of 6 No bedsits to 4 No one bedroom flats on ground and first floor of existing residential buildings
